title: NPDev Knowledge Card
description: One durable platform finding (gotcha, gap, constraint, error->fix pair, or recipe), promoted from maintainer session knowledge into a machine-readable form that the AI-authoring corpus builders fan out into the RAG index, the failure-signature index, and the capability projection.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Cite it in cards that supersede it.

type.description: gotcha=a trap that wastes a cycle; gap=schema accepts it but runtime doesn't honor it; constraint=a hard rule authors must obey; error-fix=a validator diagnostic paired with its resolution; recipe=a known-good how-to.

body.description: Markdown. Kept <=4000 chars to match the RAG chunk cap so it indexes whole.

appliesTo.description: Object types / subsystems this applies to, e.g. panel, flow, bond, build-ops, browser-verification.

signature.description: For type:error-fix only -- the NORMALIZED diagnostic template (identifiers replaced with <C>/<F>/<ID>) that scripts/ai/failure_signatures.normalize() also produces from a live message, so lookups match.

fix.description: For type:error-fix only -- the resolution text/snippet.

sourceRefs.description: Provenance: ledger IDs (ARCH-15), memory slugs, file paths, or commit hashes.

supersededBy.description: id of the card that replaces this one, when status is superseded.
